privacyPage.metaDescription: How DATAhome handles information on data-home.app.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy describes the information handled by the DATAhome marketing website, data-home.app.

sections.title: Data controller
body: DATAhome is the commercial brand operated by {operator}, an individual self-employed professional in Spain. The controller for the processing described on this marketing website can be contacted at {email}.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: We collect information you choose to provide through a contact form: name, email address, optional phone number and optional message. The form also sends its source, selected locale and the page URL from which it was submitted.

sections.title: Contact enquiries
body: When you submit a contact enquiry, the browser sends it to the DATAhome endpoint at /api/leads. The endpoint forwards the enquiry through Resend to the configured DATAhome contact recipient so that we can read and respond to your request.
We use the information in an enquiry to handle the conversation you initiated. We do not state that the marketing website stores contact enquiries in its own database.

sections.title: Anti-abuse and security
body: To protect the contact service from abuse, the endpoint may temporarily use IP information received with the request to apply rate limiting. This operational record is kept in application memory for the rate-limit window and is not presented as a visitor profile.

sections.title: Analytics
body: DATAhome uses Vercel Analytics only after you choose “Accept all” in the privacy preferences. Before a choice, and after “Essential only”, the marketing website does not mount or activate Vercel Analytics.
This policy describes DATAhome’s consent behaviour. It does not make assumptions about the internal storage or processing behaviour of Vercel Analytics.

sections.title: Local preferences
body: Your privacy preference is stored locally in your browser under datahome_cookie_consent_v1. It records your Essential only or Accept all choice and the date of that choice. This is functional local storage; it is not an advertising mechanism and is not itself a cookie.

sections.title: External services and technical sources
body: Resend is used to deliver contact enquiries to DATAhome. Vercel Analytics is available only after the analytics-enabled preference has been selected. The website may also retrieve or display public property information or media through external technical sources, including DATAhome application services and property-media sources.

Links to DATAhome registration, demo and template-preview environments take you to separate destinations. This policy describes data-home.app and does not claim to describe processing that may occur after you leave this marketing website.

sections.title: Retention
body: Contact enquiries are retained for a maximum of {months} months, unless the enquiry develops into a commercial or contractual relationship or an applicable legal obligation requires a different retention period.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Contact enquiry information is sent to the DATAhome contact recipient configured for the service and is delivered through Resend. Technical providers may process information as needed to operate the website and its services. We do not sell contact enquiry information.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some technical providers may process information outside your country. The location and safeguards applicable to a provider depend on that provider’s service and configuration. Contact us at {email} if you need information about the processing relevant to your enquiry.

sections.title: Your rights and how to exercise them
body: Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction or objection in relation to your personal information, and to raise a concern with a competent authority. To make a request about information handled through this marketing website, write to {email}.

sections.title: Updates to this policy
body: We may update this policy when the marketing website or its processing changes. The latest version is published on this page.

sections.title: Website publisher and operator

sections.title: Website purpose
body: data-home.app presents DATAhome and its marketing information for real-estate agencies, networks and property-data workflows. It may link to separate DATAhome application, demo, registration and template-preview environments.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The DATAhome name, website content, design, software visuals and other materials are protected where applicable. They may not be reproduced or used beyond what applicable law permits without prior permission from the relevant rights holder.

sections.title: External links and services
body: This website may link to external destinations or display content made available through external technical sources. Those destinations remain responsible for their own content, availability and privacy information. A link does not by itself establish an endorsement or commercial partnership.

sections.title: Liability
body: We aim to keep the information on this website accurate and current, but it is provided for general information. Nothing on the marketing website replaces a specific contractual proposal, product agreement or professional advice.

sections.title: Applicable framework
body: This website is published from Spain. Mandatory rules of applicable law and the jurisdiction of competent authorities apply where relevant.
